name: super-ia
description: Orchestrateur local et multi-fournisseurs pour agents IA de développement.

scripts.doctor: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js doctor
scripts.readiness: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js readiness
scripts.control: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js control status
scripts.context: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js context build
scripts.security: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js security scan
scripts.sandbox-check: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js security sandbox-check
scripts.validate: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js validate
scripts.backup: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js backup create
scripts.restic: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js restic status
scripts.daemon: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js daemon
scripts.matrix: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js matrix
scripts.web: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js web
scripts.notify: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js notify status
scripts.safety: npm run build --silent && node dist/index.js safety status
